alcohol.answer: Avianca's help center says bottled alcoholic beverages are not permitted in checked baggage. On domestic flights they may go in carry-on baggage only, up to 5 litres per passenger and no bottle above 70% alcohol by volume. On international flights you must check the rules of the origin and destination countries first.

sections.p: From the Avianca help center article "Can I carry food and drinks in my baggage?" (English), read on 22 November 2026.

Sealed in airtight containers; perishable food not accepted in checked baggage

list: Not on the page: how the 100 ml cabin liquid limit applies to a bottle on international flights. Ask Avianca or your departure airport.

faq: Can I put a bottle of alcohol in my checked bag on Avianca?
No. Avianca says bottled alcoholic beverages are not permitted in checked baggage.
How much alcohol can I carry on an Avianca domestic flight?
Up to 5 litres per passenger in carry-on, each bottle at 70% abv or less.
